label: token-identity mix: s/v/b/j/n/f/2/3 inputs early in original phase, or outputting n/2/k/1 in copy phase
explanation: Diffuse unit, active on about 5% of steps in 40% of sequences, with mass split between the original phase (57%) and the copy phase (43%). It never fires at t=0 and almost never at the delimiter. Component 1 (original phase): the input is one of s, v, b, j, n, f, 2, 3, mostly at positions 1-4 (t=1-2 carry about 34% of mass). Component 2 (copy phase): the output token is n, 2, k or 1 (rate about 21% for n and 2), most often at recall_idx 1-2. The preceding token also matters: rates are higher after b, 3, i, m, d, s; adding that condition raises precision to 0.44 but drops mass recall to 0.43. Firing depends on combinations of tokens and is not captured by any simple rule. Precision stays low (about 0.2) because most steps with these tokens do not fire. Not modulated by L, digit count, or copy correctness. Top activations (0.35-0.37) come in the copy phase at recall_idx 1-2 when outputting n or 2, or at early original steps such as b b s.
